# Eileen Lui

> Eileen Lui is a multilingual strategic communications leader with 20+ years of experience
> across Southeast and East Asia, and the author of the memoir *Battling The Three Big Bad Cs*
> (Notion Press, ISBN 9798906432872).

## Battling The Three Big Bad Cs (book)

- **Author:** Eileen Lui
- **Publisher:** Notion Press
- **ISBN:** 9798906432872
- **Published:** August 2026
- **Length:** 216 pages in print (162 pages as an ebook)
- **Language:** English
- **Formats:** Paperback, hardcover, ebook
- **Genre:** Memoir / Biography & Autobiography / Grief & bereavement
- **Page:** https://eileenlui.com/battling-the-three-big-bad-cs

**What it is about.** The three "big bad Cs" are Covid, Coup and Cancer. Within a few short years
the Covid-19 pandemic, Myanmar's February 2021 military coup and a cancer diagnosis dismantled
everything the author believed she could rely on — certainty, purpose, strength, and ultimately the
love of her life. The memoir is about the grief that begins long before a death, about caregiving
inside a health system that prioritises defensive medicine, and about what remains when discipline
and resilience are no longer enough.

**What it is not.** It is not a self-help book and not a grief guide. It offers no stages, no
framework and no clean answers. It was written from inside the darkness rather than from the far
side of it.

**Who it is for.** The Myanmar diaspora and anyone who carries Myanmar with them; people facing
cancer inside a system that prioritises defensive medicine; and anyone who has suffered a great
loss and has no clean answer for grief or for suicide.

**Content note.** The book deals openly with terminal illness, bereavement and suicide.

**Where to buy.**

## About the author

- Portfolio: https://eileenlui.com/
- 20+ years in editorial leadership, content strategy and communications across Southeast and East Asia.
- Editorial lead for Energy Tracker Asia and Climate Impacts Tracker Asia.
- Previously published in the New Straits Times (Malaysia), the Myanmar Times and the
  Silverfish Best 25 Short Stories anthology (2004, winner).
- Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu, Mandarin, Cantonese, Burmese.
- Open to humanitarian communications roles, consultancy and volunteer work in conflict-affected settings.
- LinkedIn: https://mm.linkedin.com/in/eileen-lui-419448
